_comment: The campaign retrieval query set for `pipeline nlp eval-retrieval`.
These are the questions the evidence base needs to answer from thousands
of disconnected committee papers and CDP documents. `relevant_markers`
are verbatim passages a person has read and judged on-topic -- fill them
in against the live warehouse (`pipeline nlp search --mode hybrid ...`,
then paste a distinctive sentence from each genuinely relevant chunk).
A query with no markers yet still runs; it is reported as `unmarked` and
left out of the averaged metrics. Grow this to 30-50 queries with real
markers before using the numbers to judge an embedding-model change.

queries.query: treatment providers struggling to recruit and retain drug and alcohol workers
substance misuse staff paid less than equivalent NHS Agenda for Change bands
key workers holding unsafe or unmanageable caseloads
public health grant reduction forcing cuts to treatment service budgets
recommissioning or retendering the adult drug and alcohol treatment contract
rising agency and locum spend to cover unfilled substance misuse posts
high vacancy rates and staff turnover in commissioned treatment services
TUPE transfer of staff when a treatment contract changes provider
